label: Crown gold
tooltip: Gold in the CROWN's treasury — the realm's, not your house's. The crown's share of the realm's taxes fills it; salaries, the court and your orders empty it; it alone buys land across the border.

label: Civil goods
tooltip: Civil goods, in gold: food, timber, cloth and wares. The harvest and your provinces fill them each month; the court eats from them and building spends them.

label: Strategic goods
tooltip: Strategic goods, in gold: iron, horses, arms and ships. Your provinces fill them each month; the levy and the campaign spend them — the army goes as far as they stretch.

label: Your gold
tooltip: Gold in your OWN house's purse, apart from the crown's treasury. Your own provinces' manors fill it each month; it buys and builds manors inside the realm.

label: Your strategic goods
tooltip: Strategic goods your own provinces make, yours to spend as their lord.

label: Your civil goods
tooltip: Civil goods your own provinces make — timber, cloth and food for building on your own manors.

label: People
tooltip: Everyone in the realm's towns and countryside. Levies are drawn from them.

label: Host
tooltip: The realm's soldiers under arms, by regiment.

label: Army
tooltip: How well drilled the levies are. Drills lapse without fresh levies.

label: Unrest
tooltip: How close the villages are to rioting. Tax pressure and famine raise it.

label: Legitimacy
tooltip: How firmly the court believes the crown is yours by right.

label: Contentment
tooltip: The mood of the common folk.

label: Church
tooltip: How the pulpits regard the crown.

label: Infantry
tooltip: Foot soldiers: the bulk of any host.

label: Archers
tooltip: Bowmen who thin a charge before it lands.

label: Cavalry
tooltip: Mounted troops: costly, and decisive on open ground.

label: Artillery
tooltip: Siege engines and guns; slow, but walls fear them.

label: Fleet
tooltip: Warships crewed from the coast towns.

label: Walls
tooltip: A walled town: harder to take, and its market is taxed at the gate.

label: Citadel
tooltip: A citadel commands the town; a garrison can hold it.

label: Temple
tooltip: A temple: the church has a house here.

label: Market
tooltip: A market square: goods change hands and the town grows.

label: Shanty town
tooltip: A shanty town outside the walls: the poor crowd in.

label: Port
tooltip: A harbour: ships and sea trade come and go.

label: Food
tooltip: Food goods.

label: Ore
tooltip: Ores and metals.

label: Mineral
tooltip: Quarried and mined minerals.

label: Building
tooltip: Building materials.

label: Luxury
tooltip: Luxuries the wealthy pay for.

label: Arms
tooltip: Goods of war.

label: Naval
tooltip: Goods for ships.

label: Cloth
tooltip: Cloth and clothing.

label: Fuel
tooltip: Fuel.

label: Coin
tooltip: Coin.

label: Supply
tooltip: Beasts and supplies.

label: Preserving
tooltip: Salt and what keeps food from spoiling.

label: Ritual
tooltip: Goods for the church and its rites.

label: Storage
tooltip: Barrels and what goods are kept in.

label: Fishing
tooltip: What the waters give.

label: Learning
tooltip: Books and the tools of learning.

label: Wealth
tooltip: What the town produces in a season.

label: Treasury
tooltip: Coin in the town's own chest.

label: The crown
tooltip: The crown's own — the realm's treasury and stores.

label: Pause
tooltip: Stop the days.

label: Play
tooltip: Let the days run.

label: Faster
tooltip: Days pass faster.

label: Fastest
tooltip: Days pass fastest.

label: Menu
tooltip: Save, load, restart or quit.

label: Towns
tooltip: The realm's townsfolk: everyone living inside a burg's walls or streets.

label: Country
tooltip: The realm's country folk: everyone on the land, in villages and on farms.

label: Manor house
tooltip: A stone hall for the steward: rents in full, a yard that can be held, a lord in residence.

label: Mill
tooltip: A mill: the manor grinds its own grain and sends flour to the royal granaries.

label: Granary
tooltip: A stone granary: the harvest keeps.

label: Chapel
tooltip: A chapel with its own priest: the pulpit speaks well of the crown.

label: Palisade
tooltip: A ditch and timber wall: a raid has to work for it, and the villages sleep easier.

label: Market
tooltip: A weekly market by charter: tolls, stall rents, and cloth changing hands.

label: Held by
tooltip: The house that holds the manor.

label: Province
tooltip: The province the manor lies in.

label: Seat
tooltip: The town that stands in the manor.

label: Terrain
tooltip: The land the manor stands on.

label: Land
tooltip: How kindly the ground is to farming.

label: Area
tooltip: How much land the manor covers.

label: People
tooltip: Everyone living on the manor, its town included.

label: Tax
tooltip: The gold the manor pays a month, its town's tariff included.

label: Strategic goods
tooltip: What the manor's strategic goods are worth a month.

label: Civil goods
tooltip: What the manor's civil goods are worth a month.

label: Chief good
tooltip: The good the manor works at.

label: Estate
tooltip: The size of the estate for its industry.

label: Defence
tooltip: How hard the manor is to take.

label: Building slots
tooltip: Room for buildings: taken of the whole.

label: Value
tooltip: What the manor is worth before anyone's feelings.

label: Price
tooltip: What the manor would cost to buy, or bring to sell.

label: Fishing quay
tooltip: a jetty and boats: only on the coast

label: Saltworks
tooltip: pans and a boiling house: on the coast or the dry salt flats

label: Sawmill
tooltip: a saw-pit and timber sheds: only where there is forest to cut

label: Stonecutter
tooltip: a masons' lodge and a crane: on high ground or at a quarry

label: Mine shaft
tooltip: a timbered adit and headframe: in the hills or where iron is already worked

label: Apiary
tooltip: a bee yard among flowers and orchards

label: Winepress
tooltip: a press house and cellar: only where vines grow

label: Tannery
tooltip: hides into leather: only where herds or trappers bring the hides

label: Loom house
tooltip: weavers at their looms: where the sheep are, or in a town

label: Smithy
tooltip: a forge by the mine: iron into tools

label: Brewery
tooltip: malt from the mill into ale: the villages are merrier

label: Shipwright
tooltip: a slipway beside the quay: boats and small ships

label: Abbey
tooltip: monks and a scriptorium where the chapel stood: the church warms, and books are copied

label: Castle
tooltip: a stone keep behind the palisade, the lord's hall within: very hard to take, and the land is quiet

label: Harbour
tooltip: a stone quay where the market meets the boats: harbour dues and a larger catch

label: Armoury
tooltip: a store of arms beside the smithy: weapons for the levy, and a harder yard

label: Terrain
tooltip: The ground the regiment is quartered on, and whether walls shelter it.

label: Height
tooltip: The height the regiment stands at and how much faster it uses supplies there; in a fight the higher side gains (owner 2026-09-19).

label: Morale
tooltip: The regiment's spirit, 0 to 100.

label: Wound recovery
tooltip: The wounded who return to the ranks each month.

label: Supplies
tooltip: The supplies the regiment holds and what it uses each month.

label: Training
tooltip: How well drilled the regiment is.

label: Strength
tooltip: How the regiment measures against the realm's others of its kind.

label: March
tooltip: How far the regiment marches in a day: its slowest arm's pace, slowed by short supplies, low morale and little training (owner 2026-09-19).
